How much the system may limit this app in the background

Stop, cache, data, permissions and battery need ADB debugging on this device.\nAndroid 11 and newer: Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → \"Pair device with pairing code\": enter the pairing port and code here, press \"Pair\".\nAndroid 10 and older or head units: turn on ADB over network (port 5555) and press \"ADB over network\".

The launcher mode is off by default. The button turns it on and, with ADB connected, sets this app as the home screen at once (without ADB the system asks you to choose: press \"Always\"). Then the first press of Home shows this menu and the second press opens the native home screen. \"Turn off\" returns the old launcher.
No app to pick a picture on this device
Or put a PNG named %2$s.png into the folder %1$s
No icon packs installed. Install one from the store and it will appear here.
Batch replace: pick a folder or a ZIP with pictures. A file is used when its name equals the package name or the app name (for example com.google.android.youtube.png or YouTube.png).
They will be removed silently through ADB.
Without ADB the system will ask to confirm each app, one after another.

Pick a folder with APK files or any archive with apps (ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, tar.gz...), tick what to install. Bundles with several parts (APKS, APKM, XAPK, ZIP with APK and OBB) are installed as one app: the parts that fit this device are chosen automatically.
They will be installed silently through ADB.
Without ADB the system installer will ask to confirm each app, one after another.
Move the icon with the arrows (touch: tap the new place). OK or \"Done\" finishes. The order is remembered.
The copy has all settings, the order of icons, hidden apps and own icons. The ADB key is not included. A copy is also saved automatically in the program folder every time you leave the program.
Save copy in the program folder

The program quietly prepares the list and icons in the background so the menu opens at once, and turns accessibility services back on if the firmware dropped them at boot (it remembers what was on; exclude a service in its Special access menu).
In launcher mode the first press of Home shows this menu, the second press opens the home screen chosen here.
Do not turn on again after boot
Done: the Home button now opens this menu
ADB is off: in the list that appears choose this app and press \"Always\"
After a launched app is closed (Back)
Return to the native home screen
Choose in the built-in file manager...
Choose a folder with apps or an archive
No access to files. Connect ADB (Settings) so the program can grant itself the right, or allow it in the system settings.
Find and install from the internet...
Search works in open catalogs: F-Droid (free software) and GitHub releases. You can also paste a direct link to an APK. Install only what you trust.
Found: %1$d. Press an app to download and install it.
This project has no APK file in its latest release
Confirm the installation in the system window
ADB is not connected: connect it in Settings. Flash drives that the system does not show are read through ADB.
Shared folders of computers, routers and NAS in your network (Windows sharing, SMB). Find them or enter the address. For open folders leave the name empty.
Nothing with shared folders found yet
Receive files over Wi-Fi (from a phone or computer)...
On your phone or computer in the same network open this address in a browser, choose APK files or archives and press \"Send\". While this window is open, the device accepts files.
No local network found. Connect the device to Wi-Fi or a cable, or turn on a hotspot on the phone and connect the device to it.

Remote: arrows move, OK opens, hold OK or Menu shows actions. Touch: tap opens, long tap shows actions, then drag to move an icon. Mouse and air mouse: left button opens, right button shows actions, the wheel scrolls, pointing highlights. The pointer itself is drawn by the system or by the air mouse; if it does not appear, switch the air mouse to mouse mode.
The folder is empty. Press \"Add icons\" or drag an icon onto another icon.
Before an app is deleted its APK is saved, so it can be installed again or rolled back to any saved version. App data is not saved.
No copies yet. They appear when you delete an app or roll it back.
Pick any saved version, a version from F-Droid or your own APK file. Going to an older version keeps app data when the system allows it; the current version is saved first.
No saved copies of this app yet
This app is not in F-Droid
Going to an older version needs ADB: connect it in Settings
This is not a usable APK file
The file belongs to another app: %1$s
No access to device storage for OBB files: connect ADB in Settings

On Android 10 and older there is no wireless debugging. Once, connect the phone to a computer with a USB cable (USB debugging on) and run: adb tcpip 5555. This window connects by itself as soon as it works.

1. Press the button below. 2. Turn on \"Wireless debugging\" and choose \"Pair device with pairing code\". 3. Pull down the notifications and type the 6-digit code in the \"App Menu\" notification. That is all: the port is found automatically.
Pairing window found (port %1$d): enter the code in the notification
Open \"Pair device with pairing code\" in the settings and type the 6-digit code here
The code has 6 digits: type it again
The pairing window is not open: choose \"Pair device with pairing code\" and type the code again
Wrong code or the window was closed: type the code again
Paired, but not connected yet: wait a few seconds or press \"Connect\"
Reads the pairing code in the system settings window and connects ADB by itself. Works only while you press \"Connect automatically\" in the app.

Fully automatic: turn on the \"App Menu\" service in Accessibility once (the button below), then press \"Connect automatically\": the program opens the settings, turns on wireless debugging and types the code by itself.
Or by hand: open \"Wireless debugging\" (code in a notification)
Stop, cache, data, permissions and battery need ADB debugging on this device. Android 10 and older or a car head unit: turn on ADB over network (port 5555) and press \"ADB over network\".
